# Intent

Add a todo resource that supports CRUD operations on JSON API endpoints related to todos. The API will accept title and completion status for individual todos with a request body that can include only the fields 'title' and 'completed'. If no title is provided, the body should not be sent. The API should return a record when requested for its title.

Additionally, the contract that is expected is a basic CRUD operation. The update endpoint should only apply to attributes present in the body, and it should return a record when updated. If no update is provided, an HTTP error code 400 should be returned with a JSON message indicating that no body was provided. The Delete endpoint should remove the record corresponding to the specified title, and it should return a record when deleted. If no title is provided, an HTTP error code 400 should be returned with a JSON message indicating that no title was provided.

require 'json'
require 'base64'

module TodoResource
  class TodosController < ApplicationController

    # POST /todos JSON API over /todos with full CRUD - list, get by id, create
    # update by id, delete by id
    def POST (req)
      @todo = Todo.new(req.body['title'] || '').tap
      unless @todo.save!
        render json: {error: "Invalid Todo"}, status: 400
      end

      render json: {status: "Created", todo_id: @todo.id }
    end

    # GET /todos JSON API over /todos with full CRUD - list, get by id, create
    # update by id, delete by id
    def GET (req)
      @todos = Todo.all
      render json: { todos: @todos }
    end

    # PATCH /todos JSON API over /todos with full CRUD - list, get by id,
    # update by id, delete by id
    def PATCH (req)
      @todo = Todo.find(req.body['id'])
      if not @todo.valid?
        render json: {error: "Invalid Todo"}, status: 400
      end

      @todo.title = req.body['title'] || ''
      if req.body.key?('completed')
        @todo.completed = req.body['completed'].present?
      end

      if @todo.save!
        render json: { status: "Updated", todo_id: @todo.id }
      end
    end

    # DELETE /todos JSON API over /todos with full CRUD - list, get by id,
    # update by id, delete by id
    def DELETE (req)
      @todo = Todo.find(req.body['id'])
      if !@todo.destroy?
        render json: {error: "Invalid Todo"}, status: 400
      end

      render json: { status: "Deleted" }
    end

      JSON.parse(req.body)
    rescue StandardError => e
      render json: { error: "Invalid JSON", message: e.message }, status: 404

require 'json'

class TodosController < ApplicationController

  def create
    todo = Todo.new body: params[:todo]
    authorize_task(todo)
    if todo.save
      render :json, todos: Todo.all, status: 201
    else
      render json errors: todo.errors.full_messages, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def update{id}
    authorize_task(params[:todo])
    todo = Todo.find(id)
    if todo.update params[:todo]
      render :json, todos: Todo.all, status: 201
    else
      render json errors: todo.errors.full_messages, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def destroy{id}
    authorize_task(params[:todo])
    Todo.find(id).destroy
    head :no_content
  end

  def index
    authorize_task(params[:todo])
    todos = Todo.all
    render :json, todos: todos, status: 200
  end

  private

  def authorize_task(task)
    if task.completed
      raise InvalidTodoError, "Cannot create or update completed todos"
    end

    unless task.todos.any?
      raise ValidationTodoError, "Cannot update incomplete todos"
    end
  end

end

      expect(JSON.parse(response.body)).to eq([{ "id": todo.id, "title": "Test Todo", "completed": false }])
    end
  end

  describe "GET /todos/:id" do
    it "returns a single todo by ID" do
      todo = Todo.create(title: "Test Todo")
      get "/todos/#{todo.id}"
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
      expect(JSON.parse(response.body)).to eq({ "id": todo.id, "title": "Test Todo", "completed": false })
    end

    it "returns a 404 not found for non-existent todo ID" do
      get "/todos/1"
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:not_found)
    end
  end

  describe "POST /todos" do
    it "creates a new todo" do
      post '/todos', params: { todo: { title: "New Todo" } }
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:created)
      expect(todo = Todo.find_by(title: "New Todo")).not_to be_nil
    end

    it "returns a 400 bad request for missing attributes" do

      expect(response).to have_http_status(:bad_request)

      expect(json).to eq({

      expect(response).to be_successful
    end

      get :show, params: { id: todo.id }
      expect(response.body).to include(todo.title)
    end
  end

      it 'creates a new todo' do
        expect {
          post :create, params: { todo: { title: 'Todo', completed: false } }
        }.to change(Todo, :count).by(1)
      end

      it 'returns a success response' do

        expect(response).to have_http_status(:created)
      end
    end

    context 'with invalid parameters' do
      it 'returns an error response' do
        post :create, params: { todo: { title: '', completed: false } }
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:unprocessable_entity)
      end
    end
  end

    context 'with valid parameters' do
      it 'updates the specified todo' do
        todo = Todo.create!(title: 'Todo', completed: false)
        put :update, params: { id: todo.id, todo: { title: 'Updated Todo' } }
        expect(todo.reload.title).to eq('Updated Todo')
      end

      it 'returns a success response' do
        todo = Todo.create!(title: 'Todo', completed: false)
        put :update, params: { id: todo.id, todo: { title: 'Updated Todo' } }

  end

require 'rails_helper'

RSpec.describe 'Todos API', type: :request do
  let!(:todos) { create_list(:todo, 10) }
  let(:todo_id) { todos.first.id }

  # Test suite for GET /todos
  describe 'GET /todos' do
    before { get '/todos' }

    it 'returns todos' do
      expect(json).not_to be_empty
      expect(json.size).to eq(10)
    end

    it 'returns status code 200' do
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
    end
  end

  # Test suite for GET /todos/:id
  describe 'GET /todos/:id' do
    before { get "/todos/#{todo_id}" }

    context 'when record exists' do
      it 'returns the todo' do
        expect(json).not_to be_empty
        expect(json['id']).to eq(todo_id)
      end

      it 'returns status code 200' do
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
      end
    end

    context 'when record does not exist' do
      let(:todo_id) { 100 }

      it 'returns status code 404' do
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:not_found)
      end

      it 'returns a not found message' do
        expect(response.body).to match(/"error":"Todo not found"/)
      end
    end
  end

  # Test suite for POST /todos
  describe 'POST /todos' do
    let(:valid_attributes) { { title: 'Learn Rails', completed: false } }

    context 'when the request is valid' do
      before { post '/todos', params: valid_attributes }

      it 'creates a todo' do
        expect(json['title']).to eq('Learn Rails')
        expect(json['completed']).to be_falsey
      end

      it 'returns status code 201' do
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:created)
      end
    end

    context 'when the request is invalid' do
      before { post '/todos', params: { title: nil, completed: false } }

      it 'returns status code 422' do
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:unprocessable_entity)
      end

      it 'returns a validation failure message' do
        expect(json['title']).to include("can't be blank")
      end
    end
  end

  # Test suite for PUT /todos/:id
  describe 'PUT /todos/:id' do
    let(:valid_attributes) { { title: 'Learn Rails API', completed: true } }

    context 'when the request is valid' do
      before { put "/todos/#{todo_id}", params: valid_attributes }

      it 'updates the todo' do
        expect(response.body).to be_empty
      end

      it 'returns status code 200' do
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
      end
    end

    context 'when the request is invalid' do
      before { put "/todos/#{todo_id}", params: { title: nil } }

      it 'returns status code 422' do
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:unprocessable_entity)
      end

      it 'returns a validation failure message' do
        expect(json['title']).to include("can't be blank")
      end
    end
  end

  # Test suite for DELETE /todos/:id
  describe 'DELETE /todos/:id' do
    before { delete "/todos/#{todo_id}" }

    it 'returns status code 204' do
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:no_content)
    end
  end
end

        expect(response.location).to be_present
      end
    end

    context "with invalid params" do
      it "renders a JSON response with errors for the new todo" do
        post :create, params: { todo: invalid_attributes }
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:unprocessable_entity)
        expect(response.content_type).to eq('application/json')
      end
    end
  end

  describe "PUT #update" do
    context "with valid params" do
      let(:new_attributes) {
        { title: "Buy bread", completed: true }
      }

        expect(response.content_type).to eq('application/json')

require 'rails_helper'

RSpec.describe 'Todos API', type: :request do
  let!(:todos) { create_list(:todo, 10) }
  let(:todo_id) { todos.first.id }

  describe 'GET /todos' do
    it 'returns all todos' do
      get '/todos'
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)
      expect(json.size).to eq(10)
    end
  end

  describe 'GET /todos/:id' do
    context 'when the record exists' do
      it 'returns the todo' do
        get "/todos/#{todo_id}"
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)
        expect(json['id']).to eq(todo_id)
      end
    end

    context 'when the record does not exist' do
      it 'returns a not found message' do
        get '/todos/100'
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:not_found)
        expect(json['error']).to eq('Todo not found')
      end
    end
  end

  describe 'POST /todos' do
    context 'with valid parameters' do
      it 'creates a new todo' do
        expect {
          post '/todos', params: { todo: { title: 'Learn Rails', completed: false } }
        }.to change(Todo, :count).by(1)

        expect(response).to have_http_status(:created)
        expect(json['title']).to eq('Learn Rails')
      end
    end

    context 'with invalid parameters' do
      it 'returns unprocessable entity status' do
        post '/todos', params: { todo: { title: nil, completed: false } }
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:unprocessable_entity)
        expect(json['errors']).to be_present
      end
    end
  end

  describe 'PUT /todos/:id' do
    context 'with valid parameters' do
      it 'updates the todo' do
        put "/todos/#{todo_id}", params: { todo: { title: 'Learn Rails API', completed: true } }
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)
        expect(json['title']).to eq('Learn Rails API')
      end
    end

    context 'with invalid parameters' do
      it 'returns unprocessable entity status' do
        put "/todos/#{todo_id}", params: { todo: { title: nil, completed: true } }
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:unprocessable_entity)
        expect(json['errors']).to be_present
      end
    end

    context 'when the record does not exist' do
      it 'returns a not found message' do
        put '/todos/100', params: { todo: { title: 'Learn Rails API', completed: true } }
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:not_found)
        expect(json['error']).to eq('Todo not found')
      end
    end
  end

  describe 'DELETE /todos/:id' do
    context 'when the record exists' do
      it 'deletes the todo' do
        expect {
          delete "/todos/#{todo_id}"
        }.to change(Todo, :count).by(-1)

        expect(response).to have_http_status(:no_content)
      end
    end

    context 'when the record does not exist' do
      it 'returns a not found message' do
        delete '/todos/100'
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:not_found)
        expect(json['error']).to eq('Todo not found')
      end
    end
  end
end
